Since I want to maximize profit, I'll bid slightly less than my value to create potential profit margin. Given the $0-$49 range and three bidders, I'll bid $28 - this leaves me a potential $3 profit if I win, while reducing the risk of overbidding and losing money.

I want to bid just enough to have a chance of winning, but not so much that I lose money if I win. Given the $49 endowment and $6 value, I'll bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances while minimizing potential loss.
